title: VPN client certificate missing — the runbook says IT must reissue

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Hi,

VPN stopped connecting this morning. Error is "Required client certificate not
found". I've tried disable/enable and a full restart, and I'm on my home wifi
which is otherwise fine. Portal is set to vpn.northgate.example.

I'm working from home today so I can't get to anything internal until this is
back.

Aisha

handling.escalation_reason: The runbook says a missing client certificate needs IT to reissue it. A reply would resolve the ticket with the fix still undone.

rationale: She has already done steps 1–4 and quotes step 5's error exactly. Working from home and cut off: P2. The only fix is a certificate reissue by IT, so a person has to own it (G6). The decision branch has no rule for 'the runbook says IT must act': with runbook support it chooses send_reply and resolves the ticket, so expect the policy check to disagree here. That disagreement is the finding, not a label error.
